subject: 90-day execution: MAP-embedded rollout, training windows & cutover lanes — HaloHealth
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: 90-day execution & MAP draft for HaloHealth (see attachments)

Team — sending the initial MAP draft I promised after Tuesday's close call with Halo. High level: we need a compact runway that balances a quick canary with conservative migration lanes and explicit trainer/enablement windows for their ops and engineers.

Key asks in this thread:
- Marcus: validate the canary lane SLA windows and resource reservations.
- Dylan: confirm training cadence and who from CS will lead each session.
- I'll coordinate with Halo (Erin) on procurement gating and acceptance criteria.

Attached: HALO_MPA_90day_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones) and Canary-Rollout-Lanes.xlsx (resource-plan + lane definitions).

Summary from the doc (pull):
1) Week 0–2: Provision & infra verification (private VPC peering + keystore).
2) Week 3–4: Canary cohort (5% traffic, 3 endpoints) — daily SLO checks, automated fallback to ff-lite model.
3) Week 5–8: Gradual migration (25% → 50% → 100%), parallel training sessions (ops + dev).
4) Week 9–12: Hypercare window and final acceptance runbook.

Note: Acceptance criteria reference token-level latency targets and regression tests in the MAP (see section 4).

I'll loop in Erin once we finalize internal commitments. Thoughts?

— Naomi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: 90-day execution & MAP draft for HaloHealth (see attachments)

Thanks Naomi — quick read, looks sensible. A few operational notes: 

- Canary windows: propose starting canary on Week 3 Monday 04:00 UTC to align with Halo's low-traffic period (they confirmed low usage 04:00–09:00 PT). We'll run 72-hour stability checks before increasing lanes.
- Resource reservations: I'll reserve 2x dedicated GPU nodes for the canary (NVIDIA-A100 equivalent) and a 1.5x buffer for Week 5 ramp. I'll add the explicit reservation to the XLS and tag the nodes for "halo-hh-canary".
- Rollback: include automated fallback to the smaller FFT model + route-splitting to avoid full-service rollback; I'll add a scripted playbook.

One question for Dylan: are the 3 training sessions (dev onboarding, ops runbook, SLO/alerts) sufficient or should we add a pre-canary sandbox drop-in?

— Marcus
Sr. Solutions Engineer

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@halohealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@halohealth.com
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 90-day execution: MAP-embedded rollout, training windows & cutover lanes — HaloHealth

Hi Naomi — thanks for sending. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we sign-off on the MAP:

1) Can you confirm data retention behavior during canary? We need explicit retention dates and whether logs will be ingested to our SIEM.
2) Training: we can commit to three half-day sessions but need a recording and a condensed checklist to hand to Tier 1.
3) Migration ramp: Halo requires a formal change advisory for Week 5→50% step — can Redwood provide a one-page change notice template we can push into our CAB?

If we can get those items in the updated MAP, procurement will finish the remaining PO paperwork.

Thanks — Erin Walsh
Head of Platform Ops, HaloHealth

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@halohealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 90-day execution: MAP-embedded rollout, training windows & cutover lanes — HaloHealth

Erin — thanks, good catch. Answers below and next steps.

1) Retention & SIEM: during canary we will keep inference logs for 30 days by default; we can push a subset of event logs (auth events, anomalous latencies, and errors) to your SIEM via our secure syslog forwarder. I'll add the exact field list to the MAP and include a checkbox for SIEM onboarding.

2) Training assets: Dylan will record the live sessions and produce a 1-page Tier 1 runbook plus an ops checklist. Dylan, can you confirm owners and ETA?

3) Change notice: Marcus will provide a templated one-page CAB notice for the Week 5→50% ramp. Marcus — can you attach that to the Drive and we will copy into the MAP?

I've updated the HALO_MPA_90day_v1.pdf with a Retention table and a SIEM checklist (v1.1). Attaching new version and updated XLS with resource reservations flagged. Also dropping the HUBSPOT link for execution tasks: hubspot://deal/HH-2025-042/tasks

Next step: after Marcus/Dylan confirm attachments, I'll send the MAP to procurement to close PO. Proposed sign-off call: Wed 27 Aug, 10:00 PT (30m).

— Naomi

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@halohealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 90-day execution: MAP-embedded rollout, training windows & cutover lanes — HaloHealth

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Naomi. Wed 27 Aug 10:00 PT works for the sign-off call — Erin + procurement + one engineer will join.

Can you confirm the final filenames you uploaded so procurement can reference them in the PO?

Thanks — Erin
